Interface PluginManager

public interface PluginManager
This class provides access to plugins that have been detected by Micro-Manager at startup. You can access the PluginManager via Studio.plugins() or Studio.getPluginManager().

  • Method Details

    • getProcessorPlugins

      HashMap<String, ProcessorPlugin> getProcessorPlugins()
      Return a HashMap that maps plugin class names to ProcessorPlugin instances. ProcessorPlugins are used to construct pipelines that modify images as they are acquired (see DataManager.createPipeline()).
      Returns:
      HashMap that maps plugin class names to ProcessorPlugin instances

    • getOverlayPlugins

      HashMap<String, OverlayPlugin> getOverlayPlugins()
      Return a HashMap that maps plugin class names to OverlayPlugin instances. OverlayPlugins are used to draw on top of images in the image display window.
      Returns:
      HashMap that maps plugin class names to OverlayPlugin instances

    • getMenuPlugins

      HashMap<String, MenuPlugin> getMenuPlugins()
      Return a HashMap that maps plugin class names to MenuPlugin instances. MenuPlugins are normally available under the "Plugins" menu; this method allows plugins to talk to each other without explicitly depending on each other.
      Returns:
      HashMap that maps plugin class names to MenuPlugin instances

    • getAutofocusPlugins

      HashMap<String, AutofocusPlugin> getAutofocusPlugins()
      Return a HashMap that maps plugin class names to AutofocusPlugin instances. AutofocusPlugins are used to perform autofocus operations.
      Returns:
      HashMap that maps plugin class names to AutofocusPlugin instances

    • getIntroPlugins

      HashMap<String, IntroPlugin> getIntroPlugins()
      Return a HashMap that maps plugin class names to IntroPlugin instances. IntroPlugins are used to customize the intro dialog at the start of the program. Ordinarily there should only be at most one of this kind of plugin installed at a time.
      Returns:
      HashMap that maps plugin class names to IntroPlugin instances

    • getQuickAccessPlugins

      HashMap<String, QuickAccessPlugin> getQuickAccessPlugins()
      Return a HashMap that maps plugin class names to QuickAccessPlugin instances. QuickAccessPlugins are for controls that can be included in the Quick-Access Window.
      Returns:
      HashMap that maps plugin class names to QuickAccessPlugin instances

    • getInspectorPlugins

      HashMap<String, InspectorPanelPlugin> getInspectorPlugins()
      Return a HashMap that maps plugin class names to InspectorPlugin instances. InspectorPlugins create the panels in the Inspector windows.
      Returns:
      HashMap that maps plugin class names to InspectorPlugin instances

    • getDisplayGearMenuPlugins

      HashMap<String, DisplayGearMenuPlugin> getDisplayGearMenuPlugins()
      Return a HashMap that maps plugin class names to DisplayGearMenuPlugin instances. DisplayGearMenuPlugins add entries to the gear menus in DisplayWindows.
      Returns:
      HashMap that maps plugin class names to DisplayGearMenuPlugin instances

    • getDataViewerGearMenuPlugins

      default HashMap<String, DataViewerGearMenuPlugin> getDataViewerGearMenuPlugins()
      Return a HashMap that maps plugin class names to DataViewerGearMenuPlugin instances. DataViewerGearMenuPlugins add entries to the gear menus of viewers that are DataViewers but not DisplayWindows, such as the TiledDataViewer.

      Defaults to reporting no such plugins, so that implementations written before this plugin type existed keep working.

      Returns:
      HashMap that maps plugin class names to DataViewerGearMenuPlugin instances

    • getTiledDataOpenerPlugins

      default HashMap<String, TiledDataOpenerPlugin> getTiledDataOpenerPlugins()
      Return a HashMap that maps plugin class names to TiledDataOpenerPlugin instances. TiledDataOpenerPlugins open tiled (pyramidal) datasets, such as OME-Zarr or tiled NDTiff, that the standard data loading path cannot handle.

      Defaults to reporting no such plugins, so that implementations written before this plugin type existed keep working.

      Returns:
      HashMap that maps plugin class names to TiledDataOpenerPlugin instances
